args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (FIN-212)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` was using ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and the test expectations:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")`

CI has passed on this branch.
